era.zh: 西周早期（约公元前11世纪）
era.en: Early Western Zhou Dynasty (c. 11th century BC)

type.en: Round belly, two handles, ring foot

description.zh: 记载了武王伐纣的历史事件，是研究西周早期历史的重要实物资料。
description.en: Records the historical event of King Wu's conquest of Shang, an important artifact for studying early Western Zhou history.

summary.zh: 一件记载了“武王伐纣”这一重大历史事件的青铜器。
summary.en: A bronze vessel that records the major historical event of "King Wu's Conquest of Shang".

type.en: Large set of bronze chime bells

description.zh: 中国迄今发现数量最多、保存最好、音律最全的一套编钟，代表了中国先秦礼乐文明的最高成就。
description.en: The largest, best-preserved, and most complete set of chime bells discovered in China, representing the highest achievement of pre-Qin ritual and music civilization.

summary.zh: 一套改写世界音乐史、代表先秦礼乐文明巅峰的国之重器。
summary.en: A national treasure that rewrote the history of world music and represents the peak of pre-Qin ritual and music civilization.

name.en: Erlitou Bronze Jue with Nipple Pattern

type.en: Long spout, pointed tail, waisted body, three legs

description.zh: 中国最早的青铜礼器之一，被誉为“华夏第一爵”，是夏代青铜铸造技术的代表。
description.en: One of the earliest bronze ritual vessels in China, known as the "First Jue of China", representing Xia Dynasty bronze casting technology.

summary.zh: 被誉为“华夏第一爵”，是中国青铜礼器的开山之作。
summary.en: Known as the "First Jue of China", the pioneering work of Chinese bronze ritual vessels.

era.zh: 商代后期（约公元前14-11世纪）

type.en: Square belly, two handles, four legs

description.zh: 目前世界上出土最大、最重的青铜礼器，享有“镇国之宝”的美誉。
description.en: The largest and heaviest bronze ritual vessel unearthed in the world, known as the "Treasure of the Nation".

summary.zh: 世界上出土最大、最重的青铜礼器，商代青铜铸造的巅峰。
summary.en: The largest and heaviest bronze ritual vessel in the world, the pinnacle of Shang Dynasty bronze casting.

era.zh: 商代后期（约公元前14-11世纪）

type.en: Square mouth, long neck, square belly, ring foot

decoration.en: Ram horns, snake bodies, Taotie motifs

description.zh: 中国现存商代青铜方尊中体型最大者，采用分铸法铸造，是商代青铜工艺的杰作。
description.en: The largest surviving Shang Dynasty square Zun, cast using the sectional casting method, a masterpiece of Shang bronze craftsmanship.

summary.zh: 商代青铜器中的“臻品”，以四羊为饰，展现了极高的铸造工艺。
summary.en: The "masterpiece" of Shang bronze ware, decorated with four rams, showcasing extremely high casting craftsmanship.
